course.title: Docker — Complete Deep DevOps Course
course.description: A Docker-specific, beginner-to-advanced course focused on real development and production workflows, with detailed concepts, practicals, dedicated tasks, security, troubleshooting and a complete learning-platform capstone.
course.curriculumPolicy: Module and lesson counts are determined by the concepts required to learn this technology properly; no fixed cross-tool template is imposed.
learningOutcomes: Understand Docker from fundamentals to production usage.
Implement a production-style learning platform deployment.

modules.title: Container Fundamentals
modules.description: Containers, images, registries, isolation and why containers solve environment consistency problems.

lessons.title: Container Fundamentals
lessons.description: Containers, images, registries, isolation and why containers solve environment consistency problems.
learningObjectives: Apply Docker in a real deployment workflow.
Explain security, scaling and failure considerations.

notes.text: Containers, images, registries, isolation and why containers solve environment consistency problems.

Understand container fundamentals as an engineering problem first and a tool feature second. The student should know what problem it solves, what happens behind the scenes at a high level, how it fits into a real deployment, and what can go wrong.

Container Fundamentals becomes important when a learning platform moves from local development toward repeatable, secure and scalable delivery. The goal is to understand the operational trade-offs, not merely memorize commands.
